name: David Koch

summary.text: David Koch (1940-2019) was executive vice president of Koch Industries and, with his brother Charles, a founder and funder of Americans for Prosperity, formed in 2004 from a split in Citizens for a Sound Economy. He chaired the Americans for Prosperity Foundation until retiring in June 2018. The Koch network's groups helped finance the Tea Party protests of the Obama years, though David Koch said he was not a member of the movement. He died on August 23, 2019.
